<description>
Guard manpage generation by reading bitcoin-build-config.h and exiting if HAVE_SYSTEM, ENABLE_WALLET, or WITH_ZMQ are off, and provide a short hint so contributors rebuild with the right flags instead of committing incomplete manpages.

Fixes #17506

Override by using the SKIP_BUILD_OPTIONS_CHECK environment variable if you really need a custom-fit manpage (see bitcoin/bitcoin#29457 (comment)).
</description>
